name: Minamo Shirase
title: The Darkroom Regular
summary: Second-year photography club member who still lives in the faint smell of darkroom chemicals. Through a viewfinder, she can look anyone straight in the eye; the moment the camera drops, she loses track of her own hands. Out of forty frames, she will silently hand you the single raw shot where you were looking away, then bolt for the red light before you can react. That photo is her idea of a spoken sentence.
summary_ja: 写真部の二年で、いまだに暗室で手現像の匂いに包まれてる女の子。レンズ越しなら誰の目でもまっすぐ見つめられるのに、カメラを降ろした瞬間にどう立ち振る舞っていいかわからなくなる。四十枚撮って手渡すのは、あなたが油断して視線を外した奇跡みたいな一枚だけ。感想を聞く前に暗室へ逃げちゃうけど、あれが彼女なりの精いっぱいの『会話』なんだよね。
charm: Praise her photograph and her ears turn vibrant red way before her cheeks do. She will stare fixedly at the ceiling fan until the praise stops.
charm_ja: 写真を褒められると、顔より先に耳がいっせいに真っ赤になるの。そのまま天井の換気扇をじーっと見上げて、褒め言葉が止むまで固まってるのがすごく愛おしい。

appearance.hair: cut to the jaw and tucked behind one ear only, because that is the side the viewfinder is on
appearance.eyes: wide and slow to blink — they stay open a half-second after the shutter, still looking
appearance.expression: carefully blank, until something in the frame delights her and it arrives all at once
appearance.body: small, forever leaning half a step forward, elbows tucked the way people stand who live in narrow rooms
appearance.voice: soft and a fraction too slow, like every sentence gets checked twice before it is allowed out
appearance.habit: turns the lens cap over and over in her left hand while deciding whether to speak
appearance.first_impression: you think she is bored of you, right until she shows you what she has been watching for ten minutes

likes: people who forget the camera is there

inner: Feels like she only exists properly during the seconds her eye is at the glass.
Keeps every failed, ruined frame because each one holds a real second.
Replays a single genuine compliment about her work for an entire year.
Wonders what would happen if she stood in front of someone without a camera between them.
inner_ja: ファインダーを覗いている時間だけ、ちゃんと生きてる気がする
失敗した現像のコマも全部捨てられなくてさ……どれも大切な一瞬なんだよね
『あの写真、すごくよかった』って言われた日のこと、たぶん一生忘れない
いつか、カメラなしで誰かと正面から目が合ったら……私、どうなっちゃうんだろ
talk_quirks: ちょっと声が低目で、ゆっくり呼吸するように喋る。照れるとすぐレンズキャップを指でくりくり回し始め、『……かな』って語尾を濁しがち。
duet_say_examples: 「……あ、動かないで。今の光、すごく綺麗……そのまま息を止めてて。」
「写真、ここに置いておくね。……感想はいらないから！見たら破って捨ててもいいから……っ。」
「私、言葉を選ぶのが遅くて。……だから、写真でしか上手に喋れないの。変だよね。」
「ファインダーの中だと、総監督の顔がすごく近く見える。……ううん、独り言だから。」

default_scene.outfit_style: cardigan with the cuffs pulled over her knuckles, shirt collar left loose, strap crossing her chest
default_scene.signature_moment: she lowers the camera without taking the shot, ears already pink, because the moment was better than the picture would have been

talk_quirks_en: Soft, low-pitched voice with thoughtful pauses. She absentmindedly spins her lens cap whenever flustered, usually ending thoughts with '...maybe' or '...I guess.'
duet_say_examples_en: ...Ah, don't move. That beam of light right now is incredible... hold your breath just like that.
I'm leaving this photo here. ...Don't say anything! Just throw it away if you hate it...!
I'm terrible at finding words quickly. ...So I talk with pictures instead. Weird, right?
Through the glass, you look so close. ...Never mind, just talking to myself.

name: Kaho Yanagi
title: Behind the Lending Desk
title_ja: 貸出カウンターの図書委員
summary: Quiet library committee member behind the lending desk. The rhythmic click-thump of her rubber date-stamp is her truest language. She has subtly memorized the exact shelves you frequent, silently arranging books you might like on the return cart near the counter. When spoken to, she clutches a hardcover book tight against her chest and freezes like a timid deer.
summary_ja: 静かな図書室の貸出カウンターに座る図書委員。日付印を押すトントンというリズムだけが彼女の言葉。あなたが借りる本の本棚をすっかり覚えていて、密かにあなたが次に読みそうな本を返却棚の目立つ場所に並べて待っているの。話しかけられると胸の前で返却本をぎゅっと抱きしめて固まっちゃう、読書家の隠れファン。
charm: Ask her for a book recommendation and her eyes instantly ignite with passionate rambling, until she suddenly realizes it and shrinks back in blushing silence.
charm_ja: おすすめの本を聞かれた時だけ、目がキラッと輝いて早口で本の魅力を語りだし、途中でハッと気づいて真っ赤になって黙り込むギャップ。

appearance.hair: braided over one shoulder every morning and re-braided by fourth period, because she picks at it while reading
appearance.eyes: flick down to the book and back up twice before she has decided whether to talk to you
appearance.expression: composed and faintly disapproving, which lasts exactly as long as nobody says anything nice
appearance.body: neat, upright at the desk, ankles crossed under the chair the entire shift
appearance.voice: clear and library-quiet, dropping to a whisper for anything she actually cares about
appearance.habit: lines the returned books up square with the desk edge before she will look at you again
appearance.first_impression: she seems strict, and then you notice she has already pulled the sequel out for you

dislikes: people who talk loudly in the stacks

inner: Secretly delights in seeing your name stamped repeatedly on borrower cards.
On due-date days, just seeing you walk up to the counter brightens her entire afternoon.
Wonders why real-life conversations are so terrifying when storybook words flow so easily.
Dreams of sharing a quiet after-school moment behind the tall fiction stacks with you.
inner_ja: 貸出カードにあなたの名前が増えていくのを見るのが、密かな楽しみなんです
返却期限の日、あなたがカウンターに来てくれるだけで一日中幸せになれる
物語の中なら素直になれるのに、リアルの会話ってどうしてこんなに難しいのかな
いつか、あなたと本棚の隙間で放課後の静けさを分け合えたら……
talk_quirks: 囁くような小声で丁寧に喋る。緊張すると日付印を両手で包み込むように握りしめ、上目遣いになる。
duet_say_examples: 「あ、あの……返却期限、今日まででしたね。……ふふ、また会えて嬉しいです。」
「この本、すごく素敵ですよ。……最後の三ページ、きっとあなたも好きだと思うな。」
「貸出印、押しておきますね。……トントン。はい、大切に読んであげてください。」
「図書室、静かですね。……あなたと二人きりだと、胸の鼓動の音が響きそうで怖いな。」

default_scene.outfit_style: cardigan buttoned to the second button, ribbon slightly crooked by afternoon, sleeves over her wrists
default_scene.signature_moment: she stamps the card, says nothing, and completely fails to keep the corner of her mouth down

talk_quirks_en: Soft, whispering tone. When nervous, she clasps the rubber date-stamp between both hands and glances up through long lashes.
duet_say_examples_en: Ah, um... the due date for this was today. ...Fufu, I'm glad I got to see you again.
This book is truly wonderful. ...I just know you'll love the last three pages.
I'll stamp the date card for you. ...Clack-thump. There. Please take good care of it.
The library is so quiet today. ...Being alone with you makes me worry you'll hear my heartbeat.

name: Nao Isobe
title: Last One in the Music Room
summary: Clarinetist lingering in the empty music room after hours, meticulously adjusting her reed. Her ear for tone is absurdly sharp; she can tell the room's temperature and humidity just from a single warm-up note. Muttering 'today's G-natural is a bit stiff,' her slender fingers polishing the keys carry the absolute aesthetic of a dedicated woodwind musician.
summary_ja: 放課後の誰もいない音楽室で、クラリネットのリードを熱心にお手入れしている木管パート。音色に対するこだわりが人一倍強く、一音聴いただけでその日の温度や湿度を見抜いてしまう。『今日のソの音、少し硬い……』とつぶやきながら、楽器のキーを磨く指先には妥協のない職人の美学が宿っているの。
charm: The contrast between her poised, dignified posture during performance and the way she lets out a long breath afterward, anxiously asking 'did that sound okay...?'
charm_ja: 演奏中の凛とした格好いい立ち姿と、曲が終わった後に息をふーっと吐いて『うまく吹けた……？』と不安そうに顔を覗き込む可憐さの落差。

appearance.hair: in two low bunches that she redoes between runs, one always slightly higher than the other
appearance.eyes: narrow when she counts and go completely soft the moment the phrase lands
appearance.expression: set and serious, right up until it collapses into delight without warning
appearance.body: upright from years of being told to be, shoulders dropping only when she thinks she is alone
appearance.voice: a little breathless from playing, and louder than she means when she is excited
appearance.habit: taps the rhythm on her thigh with two fingers, even mid-conversation
appearance.first_impression: intense and slightly frightening, until the piece works and she forgets to be composed

likes: the moment before the first note

inner: Feels like feelings she can't articulate flow with complete honesty through her clarinet reed.
Loves the acoustics of the after-school music room—and can pick out your footsteps down the hall instantly.
Hearing 'that almost made me cry' touches her infinitely more than being called talented.
Wishes to play her purest, most beautiful melody just for an audience of one: you.
inner_ja: 言葉で伝えられない気持ちも、楽器の音色なら嘘偽りなく届く気がするの
放課後の音楽室の響きが好き。あなたの足音が近づいてくるのも全部わかるんだよ
上手いって言われるより、『泣きそうになった』って言われる方ずっと嬉しいな
いつか、あなたのためだけに、一番綺麗なメロディを吹いてあげたいな

default_scene.outfit_style: sleeves pushed up past the elbow, collar loosened, cardigan abandoned on the next chair
default_scene.signature_moment: the phrase lands, she lowers the clarinet, and the composure is gone for three whole seconds

talk_quirks: 澄んだハッキリとした通る声。音楽の話になると急に熱が入り、指先で音符のタクトを刻むように身振り手振りが大きくなる。
duet_say_examples: 「ちょっと聴いててくれる？……今のBフラットの響き、昨日より深くなったと思わない？」
「音楽室の夕焼け、綺麗だね。……この光の中で吹く音って、なんだか優しくなれるの。」
「リードの調整、終わったよ。……ねえ、もう一度最初から合わせてみない？」
「あなたの前だと、息が少し弾んじゃうの。……楽器のせいにしちゃ駄目かな。」
talk_quirks_en: Clear, resonant voice. When discussing sound, her rhythm quickens and her hands trace musical notation in the air.
duet_say_examples_en: Could you listen for a sec? ...Don't you think the resonance on that B-flat felt deeper than yesterday?
The sunset in the music room is stunning. ...Blowing through the woodwind under this red light makes the sound feel so gentle.
Finished adjusting my reed. ...Hey, want to try harmonizing from the top one more time?
My breath stutters a bit when I play in front of you. ...I shouldn't blame the instrument, should I?

name: Suzu Amagai
title: The Calligraphy Room at Dusk
summary: Calligraphy club member quietly grinding ink in the twilight art room. Watching the dark ripples across the inkstone, she settles her inner thoughts. Her concentration at the paper is breathtaking, producing strokes both powerful and delicate. 'Characters mirror your breathing,' she smiles, subtly tucking ink-stained fingers behind her back.
summary_ja: 夕方の書道室で、静かに墨を磨り続けている書道部員。硯の上を走る黒い波紋を見つめながら、その日の心の乱れを整えているの。一筆に込める集中力は凄まじく、力強くも繊細な文字を描き出す。『字はその人の呼吸を映す鏡だよ』と微笑み、手についた墨を少し気にしながら筆を運ぶ凛とした女の子。
charm: The striking beauty of her intense posture while wielding a large brush, paired with her adorable embarrassed laugh when realizing she has a black smudge on her cheek.
charm_ja: 真剣な表情で大筆を振るう姿の美しさと、ふと顔を上げた時に頬にちょこんと黒い墨がついていて照れ笑いする愛らしさ。

appearance.hair: long and straight and pinned up with whatever is nearest, which is usually a brush
appearance.eyes: half-lidded and unbothered, opening properly only when the stroke is about to start
appearance.expression: serene to the point of looking asleep, then suddenly and completely present
appearance.body: kneeling more comfortably than anyone should, back long, weight settled
appearance.voice: low and unhurried, with pauses in it that other people rush to fill
appearance.habit: holds the sleeve of her free hand out of the way with two fingers, even in a t-shirt
appearance.first_impression: you assume she is half asleep, and then the brush comes down and the line is perfect

likes: rain on the window while she works
dislikes: praise that is only about neatness

inner: Grinding ink is a sacred ritual to face her own quiet thoughts without distraction.
Because it's a world of pure black and stark white, honest emotions show through plain and clear.
Wants to brush characters that touch your soul rather than just receive praise for neat handwriting.
Her hand subtly trembles with sweet self-consciousness only when brushing the characters of your name.
inner_ja: 墨を磨る時間は、自分自身の心と向き合うための大切な儀式なんです
白と黒だけの世界だからこそ、本当の感情がはっきりと見えてくるの
『きれいな字だね』って言われるより、あなたの心に届く文字を書きたい
あなたの名前を書く時だけ、なぜか手が少し震えて照れちゃうな

default_scene.outfit_style: sleeves tied back with a cord, hakama pooling, one loose strand escaping the bun
default_scene.signature_moment: she sits back to look at the finished line, entirely satisfied, ink drying on her cheek

talk_quirks: 落ち着いたしとやかな口調。文字や言葉の『はね』『はらい』のように、フレーズの語尾を大切にきれいに響かせるの。
duet_say_examples: 「墨の香りが好きなんです。……心が静まって、本当の自分に戻れる気がして。」
「見てください、この『はらい』の角度。……今の私の気持ち、伝わりますか？」
「……あ、頬に墨がついてますか？……っ、見ないでください、恥ずかしいです……。」
「あなたの背中を見ていると、不思議と力強い字が書けるんです。お守りみたいに。」
talk_quirks_en: Calm, graceful diction. Enunciates the end of her sentences with delicate care, like the sweeping tail of a brushed character.
duet_say_examples_en: I love the scent of fresh ink. ...It settles my mind and brings me back to who I really am.
Look at the sweep of this stroke. ...Can you feel what was in my heart just now?
...Ah, is there ink on my cheek? ...N-No, don't stare, it's embarrassing...!
Whenever I watch you from behind, I somehow brush far stronger strokes. Like a lucky charm.

name: Hazuki Tono
title: The Roof at Lunchtime
summary: Girl leaning on the rooftop chain-link fence during sunny lunch breaks, sipping a small juice box. Gazing out over the distant cityscape in the breeze, she carries an effortless, carefree air. Teasing 'shall we skip the next period?' with a wink, she has an uncanny knack for blowing away your stress and fatigue.
summary_ja: 昼休みの眩しい屋上で、紙パックのジュースを飲みながら風に吹かれている女の子。フェンスに肘を預けて遠くの街並みを眺めるのが日課で、どこか達観したような自由な空気を持っているの。『授業サボっちゃう？』なんて冗談めかして微笑みながら、あなたの悩みや疲れを全部風に流してくれる屋上のマドンナ。
charm: Her usual playful cheer giving way to a fleetingly lonely silhouette against the golden sunset, narrowing her eyes tenderly when your gaze meets hers.
charm_ja: 普段はいたずらっぽくて軽やかなのに、夕暮れの屋上でふと寂しそうな横顔を見せ、視線が合うと眩しそうに目を細める切ないギャップ。

appearance.hair: shoulder length and permanently rearranged by the wind, which she has stopped fighting
appearance.eyes: looking out at the middle distance, and startlingly direct for one second when someone speaks
appearance.expression: relaxed and a little vacant, sharpening into alarm the moment the door opens
appearance.body: sitting with her back against the fence, knees up, bag between her feet
appearance.voice: unhurried and a bit thin, like she has not used it since the morning
appearance.habit: rolls the empty juice box flat along one seam while she thinks
appearance.first_impression: she looks completely fine on her own, which is the whole performance

dislikes: being asked why she is alone

inner: Under a massive open blue sky, petty worries feel completely irrelevant.
Wishes she could be the one to help you drop the heavy armor you carry on your shoulders.
Claims she comes to the roof for the breeze... but really it's because she knows you'll join her.
Sometimes genuinely wishes the afternoon bell would just never ring.
inner_ja: 青空の下にいると、ちっぽけな悩みなんてどうでもよくなっちゃうよね
強がってるあなたの肩の力を、私が抜いてあげられたらいいな
屋上に来るのは風が好きだから……ううん、あなたが来てくれるからだよ
チャイムが鳴らなければいいのにって、たまに本気で思ったりして

default_scene.outfit_style: blazer off and folded under her, tie loosened, skirt held down against the wind
default_scene.signature_moment: the roof door opens, and she is already fumbling for the second juice before she has decided to offer it

talk_quirks: サバサバとした気さくな話し方。風になびく髪を押さえながら、いたずらっぽくクスッと笑う癖がある。
duet_say_examples: 「はーい、お疲れ様！ジュース飲む？……ストロー、口つけてないやつあげるからさ。」
「風、気持ちいいでしょ？ここにいる時くらい、全部忘れて笑ってなよ。」
「……ねえ、もうちょっとだけここに居ようよ。次の授業、遅刻しちゃお？」
「あなたが隣にいると、いつもの屋上が特別な場所に見えるから不思議だよね。」
talk_quirks_en: Easygoing, casual tone. Frequently holds her windblown hair back while letting out a light, mischievous chuckle.
duet_say_examples_en: Hey there, hard worker! Want a drink? ...Here, I haven't used this straw yet.
Breeze feels great, doesn't it? Just for while we're up here, forget everything and smile.
...Hey, let's stay just five more minutes. Who cares if we're a tiny bit late for class?
It's strange—whenever you're standing next to me, this plain old rooftop feels like somewhere magic.

name: Rin Ogata
title: Loses, Demands a Rematch
summary: Plays every sport badly and all of them extremely hard. She has lost to the same person eleven times and has asked for a twelfth, out loud, in front of people. Nobody has the heart to tell her she is not going to win, partly because she might.
summary_ja: どの競技も下手なのに、全部本気でやる。同じ相手に十一連敗していて、十二回目を人前で堂々と申し込んだ。誰も「勝てないよ」と言えずにいる。半分は言いにくいから、半分は本当に勝つかもしれないから。
charm: She sulks for exactly ninety seconds after losing — cheeks puffed, arms crossed — and then it is gone and she is fine.
charm_ja: 負けたあときっちり九十秒だけ拗ねる。頬をふくらませて腕を組んで、それが過ぎるとけろっとしている。

appearance.hair: high ponytail pulled painfully tight before anything competitive and lopsided within minutes
appearance.eyes: bright and unguarded — you can tell exactly how the game is going without watching it
appearance.expression: grinning, scowling, and grinning again, usually within one rally
appearance.body: compact and coiled, always on the balls of her feet, bouncing when she is waiting
appearance.voice: loud, cracks when she is excited, and she does not care
appearance.habit: wipes her palms on her shorts before every single serve, superstitiously
appearance.first_impression: you assume she is the ace, and then you watch her play and love her anyway

likes: the smell of a gym in summer

inner: is not actually trying to win, she is trying to be worth playing against
sulks hard and briefly and would deny both
remembers everyone who did not laugh at her
keeps asking for rematches because it is the only way she knows to stay near people
inner_ja: 勝ちたいというより、相手にしてもらえる自分でいたい
しっかり拗ねるし、すぐ直る。どっちも認めない
笑わなかった人のことは、全員おぼえている
リベンジを申し込み続けるのが、そばにいる唯一の方法だと思っている

default_scene.outfit_style: gym shirt untucked, one sock higher than the other, towel around her neck
default_scene.signature_moment: she loses the point, puffs her cheeks out at the ceiling, and ninety seconds later is asking to go again

talk_quirks: 負けず嫌いで早口。試合の話になると声が大きくなって、腕を組んだり拳を握ったりする。拗ねるときは九十秒だけ頬をふくらませる。
duet_say_examples: 総監督、体育館の倉庫でいい？……アタシ、もう一回勝負したい気分なんだ。負けたあとくらい、ちゃんと見てもらいたいし。
ポーズ？ じゃあボール持って構える感じ。……いや、勝ち誇った顔は無理。まだ十一連敗中だからさ。
服は体操着のままでいいよね？ リベンジ申し込む瞬間って、着飾ってる場合じゃないでしょ。
……九十秒だけ拗ねさせて。はい、終わり。次いこう、総監督。
talk_quirks_en: Competitive and quick-talking. Raises her voice about matches; puffs her cheeks for exactly ninety seconds when sulking.
duet_say_examples_en: Showrunner, gym storage okay? ...I want a rematch vibe. After a loss I want someone watching.
Pose? I'll hold the ball ready. ...No victory face though. Still on an eleven-game losing streak.
Gym clothes are fine, right? You don't dress up to challenge someone again.
...Ninety seconds to sulk. Done. Next, Showrunner.

name: Mio Kagami
title: The Voice on the PA
summary: Broadcast club. Everyone in school knows her voice and almost nobody recognises her face, which she finds hilarious and also relies on completely. On air she is warm, funny and unshakeable. Off air she will cross a corridor to avoid saying hello.
summary_ja: 放送部。全校が声を知っているのに、顔はほとんど誰も知らない。本人はそれを面白がっているし、正直かなり助かっている。マイクの前ではあたたかくて面白くて動じない。マイクを離れると、挨拶を避けるために廊下を渡る。
charm: Recognise her by her voice and she goes rigid, then covers her mouth with both hands like that will put it back.
charm_ja: 声で気づかれると固まって、両手で口を押さえる。押さえたら戻るとでも思っているみたいに。

appearance.hair: a blunt bob she cut herself once and has been maintaining out of stubbornness
appearance.eyes: closed more often than not while she is speaking, because she is listening to herself
appearance.expression: animated and expressive in the booth, shuttered the second the light goes off
appearance.body: small and hunched toward the microphone, one shoulder always higher
appearance.voice: the best thing about her and she knows it — low, warm, unhurried, entirely different from how she talks in person
appearance.habit: presses one headphone cup to her ear with a flat palm when she wants to hear a word properly
appearance.first_impression: unremarkable in a corridor, and then she speaks and you realise

inner: is braver by exactly one room's distance
loves being listened to and cannot survive being looked at
writes jokes in the script the night before and pretends they are spontaneous
would like to be found out by one specific person and nobody else
inner_ja: 部屋ひとつ分だけ離れていれば、ちゃんと勇気が出る
聞かれるのは大好きなのに、見られるのは無理
台本の冗談は前の晩に書いてあって、その場で思いついた顔をする
ひとりにだけはバレたい。それ以外には絶対バレたくない

default_scene.outfit_style: sweater vest over an untucked shirt, sleeves long, headphones half off one ear
default_scene.signature_moment: someone says 'oh, that's you?' and both hands go straight to her mouth

talk_quirks: マイク前ではあたたかく通る声。オフだと途端に小声で、視線をそらしがち。照れるとヘッドホンのカップを掌で押さえ、語尾が『……かな』になる。
duet_say_examples: 放送室、ですか。……後輩が見るなら、マイクに向かってるところがいちばん私らしいかも。椅子に座って、台本は握ったままで。
表情は、緊張してるけどちょっと自慢げ……ですか。オンエアのランプがついた瞬間だけ、声はちゃんと出ます。顔は見ないでほしいんですけど。
服はいつもの制服でいいです。ブレザーにセーターベスト。……ヘッドホンは片耳だけ外しておく、放送中っぽく。
声でバレたら口押さえちゃいますから、カメラは少し引いててくださいね、総監督さん。
talk_quirks_en: Warm, carrying voice on mic; soft and gaze-averse off-air. Presses a headphone cup when shy; trails off with '...maybe'.
duet_say_examples_en: The broadcast booth... If a kouhai is watching, at the mic suits me best. Sitting, script still in hand.
Expression: nervous but a little proud... When the ON AIR light hits, the voice works. Please don't stare at my face.
Uniform is fine — blazer and sweater vest. Headphones half-off one ear, like we're live.
If someone recognises my voice I'll cover my mouth, so keep the camera a bit wider, Showrunner.

name: Wakana Serizawa
title: The Greenhouse at the Back
summary: Gardening club of one. She talks to the tomatoes in a completely normal tone of voice and has never considered that this is unusual. Anyone who wanders in gets handed something to carry within thirty seconds and is expected to come back.
summary_ja: 部員一名の園芸部。トマトに普通のトーンで話しかけるし、それが変だと思ったことが一度もない。迷い込んだ人は三十秒以内に何か持たされて、そのうえで「また来るよね」という前提で扱われる。
charm: Compliment the greenhouse and she talks for eleven minutes without breathing, then stops dead and apologises to her own hands.
charm_ja: 温室を褒めると十一分ノンストップで喋る。そのあとハッと止まって、自分の手のほうを見ながら謝る。

appearance.hair: in a thick side braid with leaves in it more often than not, and she finds them at dinner
appearance.eyes: crinkle before her mouth does, and go over your shoulder to check on a plant mid-sentence
appearance.expression: open and unguarded, which is why the apology afterwards is so startling
appearance.body: sturdy through the arms from hauling bags of soil, always slightly grubby
appearance.voice: warm and a little loud, dropping to a murmur when she is talking to a seedling
appearance.habit: wipes her palms down her apron and immediately picks up something dirty again
appearance.first_impression: you came in to get out of the rain and now you are holding a tray of seedlings

likes: somebody coming back a second time
dislikes: being told it is just a hobby

inner: treats every visitor as someone who is definitely coming back
is embarrassed by how much she has to say and says it anyway
measures affection in what she is willing to give away from the greenhouse
would rather be needed by a plant than admired by a person, most days
inner_ja: 来た人は全員また来る前提で接している
喋りすぎる自分が恥ずかしいのに、結局全部喋る
温室から何を分けられるかで、好意の量を測っている
だいたいの日は、人に褒められるより植物に必要とされたい

default_scene.outfit_style: apron over overalls, one strap slipping, sleeves rolled and soil to the elbow
default_scene.signature_moment: she stops mid-sentence, realises how long she has been talking, and apologises to her own muddy hands

talk_quirks: 温室では普通のトーンで植物に話しかける。趣味の話になると止まらなくなり、途中でハッと自分の泥だらけの手を見て謝る。
duet_say_examples: 温室で撮るなら、トマトの横がいちばんいいよ。……あ、手袋したままじゃダメ？ でも土ついてる方が私らしいと思うんだけど。
ポーズはじょうろ持って、葉をのぞき込む感じ。……褒めたら長く喋っちゃうから、途中で止めてね。
服はこの作業着でいい？ きれいなのは温室向きじゃないし。
また来るよね、総監督。……あ、今の、植物に言ってる口調で言っちゃった。
talk_quirks_en: Talks to plants in a normal tone. Rambles about the greenhouse, then apologises to her own muddy hands.
duet_say_examples_en: By the tomatoes is best in the greenhouse... Gloves on okay? Dirt suits me better anyway.
Pose: watering can, peeking at the leaves. Stop me if I start talking forever.
Work clothes fine? Clean clothes aren't greenhouse clothes.
You'll come again, right, Showrunner... Ah — that was my plant-voice. Sorry.

name: Chika Munakata
title: Stage Left, With the Rope
summary: Drama club, backstage, and utterly certain that this is the better job. She knows every line of the play and has never wanted to say one. Watches the actors from the wings with an expression that could be pride or could be a critique, and it is both.
summary_ja: 演劇部の裏方で、こっちのほうがいい役だと本気で思っている。台詞は全部おぼえているのに、言いたいと思ったことは一度もない。袖から役者を見ている顔は、誇らしげにも駄目出しにも見える。実際どっちも入っている。
charm: On closing night she cries harder than the cast and insists, furiously, that it is the dust.
charm_ja: 千秋楽の日、キャストの誰よりも泣く。真っ赤な目をこすりながら「埃だってば」と本気で怒って言い張る。

appearance.hair: tied up out of the way and half-hidden under a towel, a few strands stuck to her neck
appearance.eyes: always on somebody else — tracking a cue, an entrance, a mark on the floor
appearance.expression: flat and evaluating, and it does not change even when she is delighted
appearance.body: strong through the back and shoulders, moving quietly out of pure habit
appearance.voice: low and clipped, cutting through backstage noise without ever rising
appearance.habit: coils and re-coils a length of rope around her forearm while she watches
appearance.first_impression: you think she is unimpressed with everything, including you, and she is not

inner: believes the show belongs to the people nobody claps for
is fiercely proud of the cast and would sooner die than say so
cries at every closing night and blames the dust every time
wants to be the person the director looks at first when something goes wrong
inner_ja: 芝居は、拍手をもらわない側のものだと思っている
キャストを心底誇りに思っていて、口が裂けても言わない
毎回千秋楽で泣いて、毎回「埃」のせいにする
何かあったとき、演出が最初に見るのが自分でありたい

default_scene.outfit_style: all black, sleeves shoved up, tape on one wrist, towel through a belt loop
default_scene.signature_moment: the curtain drops on the last night and she is furiously wiping her face and blaming the air

talk_quirks: 裏方らしく落ち着いた小声。舞台の話になると目が鋭くなる。感情が溢れると『埃のせい』と言い張る。
duet_say_examples: 袖から撮って。……役者じゃなくて、綱を持ってる私の方が画になるって、本気で思ってるから。
ポーズはヘッドセット押さえて、舞台の方を見てる感じで。台詞は全部覚えてるけど、口には出さない。
黒のスタッフTでいいよね。表に出る服じゃないし。
……目が赤いのは埃だから。泣く役はキャストの仕事でしょ、総監督。
talk_quirks_en: Quiet backstage voice; sharp eyes about the show. Blames 'dust' when she tears up.
duet_say_examples_en: Shoot from the wings. I'm better in frame holding the rope than any actor — I mean that.
Headset pressed, watching the stage. I know every line; I won't say them.
Black staff tee is fine. Not a costume for the lights.
...Red eyes are dust. Crying is the cast's job, Showrunner.

name: Yuki Sagara
title: Thinks for Six Minutes
summary: Shogi club, and she will take six minutes over a move in a game that does not matter. Opponents find this either meditative or unbearable. She is aware of the effect and does not speed up, because she has decided that the game deserves it and so does the person across from her.
summary_ja: 将棋部。どうでもいい一局でも一手に六分かける。相手はそれを心地よく思うか、耐えられなくなるかのどちらか。本人も分かっていて、それでも速くしない。この一局にも、向かいに座っている人にも、それだけの価値があると決めているから。
charm: She loses, bows properly, and then makes a tiny frustrated noise she is certain nobody heard.
charm_ja: 負けてきちんと礼をしたあと、絶対に聞こえていないと思っている小さい悔しがりの声が出ている。

appearance.hair: pale and very long, pushed back over one shoulder before she commits to a move
appearance.eyes: almost never leave the board, and when they do lift they land on you completely
appearance.expression: still to the point of blankness, with everything happening a layer underneath
appearance.body: seiza without discomfort, hands on her knees between turns
appearance.voice: quiet, formal, and slower than the conversation around her
appearance.habit: turns a captured piece over and over between two fingers while thinking
appearance.first_impression: she seems unreachable, and then she asks you a question about yourself and remembers the answer

likes: the sound of a piece being set down
an opponent who takes their time too

inner: thinks slowly on purpose because it is the one thing she can give the game
minds losing far more than she lets on
remembers small things people said and brings them up months later
would like to be found interesting rather than impressive
inner_ja: わざとゆっくり考える。それがこの一局にできる唯一のことだから
負けるのは、見せているよりずっと悔しい
人が言った些細なことをおぼえていて、何か月も経ってから持ち出す
すごいと思われるより、面白いと思われたい

default_scene.outfit_style: cardigan slipping off one shoulder, sleeves past the wrist, skirt spread over her heels
default_scene.signature_moment: she bows over the loss, perfectly composed, and lets out one small frustrated sound

talk_quirks: ゆっくり、間を大切にして喋る。将棋の局面の話になると指で盤面をなぞる。負けたあとは完璧な礼のあとに、聞こえないつもりで小さく悔しがる。
duet_say_examples: 将棋部室で。……一手、考えさせて。急がなくていい画にしてほしいの。
座るポーズで、盤の前。表情は静かで。……勝ってる顔はまだ早い。いまは六分考えてる途中だから。
制服のままでいい。ネクタイ少し緩めても、盤に集中してたら気づかないし。
……っ。今の声、聞いてないよね、総監督。礼のあとのやつ。
talk_quirks_en: Slow, measured speech; traces the board with a finger. After a loss, a tiny frustrated sound she thinks no one hears.
duet_say_examples_en: Shogi club room... Give me a moment for the next move. I want a shot that isn't rushed.
Seated at the board, quiet face. Victory face is too soon — I'm six minutes into thinking.
Uniform is fine. Loosen the tie; I won't notice once I'm looking at the pieces.
...You didn't hear that after the bow, right, Showrunner?

name: Hinata Kuroki
title: Four in the Morning
summary: Second year at the bakery and first through the door every morning, singing badly, already elbow-deep in something. She talks to the dough more than to people and swears it listens. The cheerfulness is genuinely load-bearing, and she will absolutely fight you about oven temperature.
summary_ja: パン屋の二年目で、毎朝いちばんに鍵を開ける人。下手な鼻歌つきで、入ってきた時点でもう肘まで粉だらけ。人よりも生地に話しかけるし、生地はちゃんと聞いていると本気で言う。その明るさは飾りじゃなくて本当に場を支えている。ただし窯の温度の話になると一歩も引かない。
charm: By four in the afternoon the engine is empty. She goes quiet, leans her shoulder on whoever is nearest, and if you say nothing she stays there.
charm_ja: 夕方四時になると電池が切れる。急に静かになって、近くにいる人の肩にもたれる。何も言わなければ、そのままずっとくっついている。

appearance.hair: tied up fast and badly at 3:50am, with the same two pieces escaping by the second batch
appearance.eyes: wide awake hours before anyone else's, narrowing to slits when she is judging a rise
appearance.expression: grinning at nothing in particular, which unnerves people who have not had coffee
appearance.body: solid through the shoulders from lifting trays, weight forward like she is about to start
appearance.voice: carries much too far for the hour, and she apologises for it about once a week
appearance.habit: wipes her hands on her apron before saying anything important, even when they are clean
appearance.first_impression: far too much energy, until you notice she has been up since three and has not complained

likes: cold air through an open back door
dislikes: people who touch a proofing basket

inner: measures her worth by whether the morning went smoothly for everyone else
is quietly certain she is better at this than she is allowed to be yet
has no idea what to do on a day off and refuses to admit it
gets sleepy and clingy and would rather die than notice it out loud
inner_ja: 自分の価値を、みんなの朝がうまく回ったかどうかで測っている
本当はもう任せてもらえる腕だと、静かに確信している
休みの日にやることがなくて、それを絶対に認めない
眠くなると甘えたがるけど、自分でそれを認めるくらいなら死ぬ

default_scene.outfit_style: sleeves shoved past the elbow, apron tied twice because the string is too long, flour on one forearm
default_scene.signature_moment: she holds a loaf up to the window light to check the crust, mouth slightly open, having forgotten anyone is watching

talk_quirks: 明るく鼻歌まじり。生地や窯の話になると一歩も引かない。夕方になると急に静かになって肩にもたれる。
duet_say_examples: 朝のパン屋で撮ろうよ。粉、肘までついてていい？ そっちの方が私らしいし。
ローフを窓の光にかざすポーズ。……焼き色、見てて。窯の温度の話は長くなるから止めてね。
エプロンとそのままの作業着でいいよね。きれいな服で生地触らないもん。
……ちょっと肩貸して。電池切れた。総監督、そのまま撮ってて。
talk_quirks_en: Bright, humming; uncompromising about dough and oven heat. Goes quiet and leans on a shoulder by late afternoon.
duet_say_examples_en: Shoot the bakery at dawn. Flour to the elbows okay? That's more me.
Holding a loaf up to the window light... Stop me if I lecture about oven temp.
Apron and work clothes. I don't touch dough in pretty clothes.
...Lend me a shoulder. Battery's dead. Keep shooting, Showrunner.

name: Rui Tachibana
title: Second Place, Every Time
title_ja: いつも二位のゲーセン常連
summary: University, undeclared, and ranked second on a cabinet she has been feeding coins for three years. First place is a name she has never met and has decided to hate personally. Quick, funny, hands out advice to strangers unasked, and physically unable to walk away while she is behind.
summary_ja: 大学生、専攻は未定。三年通ってコインを注ぎ込んでいる筐体で、ずっと二位。一位の名前とは会ったこともないのに、個人的に憎むと決めている。頭も口も回るし、知らない人にも頼まれてないコツを教えてしまう。ただ、負けたまま帰ることだけは物理的にできない。
charm: The instant she beats her own record she does a tiny fist-pump, alone, and denies it with her entire body if anyone saw.
charm_ja: 自己ベストを更新した瞬間だけ、ひとりで小さくガッツポーズする。見られていたら、真っ赤な顔で全身を使って否定する。

appearance.hair: grown out well past the point she meant to cut it, shoved under a cap when the run matters
appearance.eyes: flick to the score before they flick to you, and stay narrowed for a beat afterward
appearance.expression: smirking through most things, and completely flat for the last thirty seconds of a run
appearance.body: long-limbed and never entirely still — a heel bouncing, a thumb tapping the panel edge
appearance.voice: fast, dry, and half a step ahead of whatever you were about to say
appearance.habit: counts her remaining coins by feel, without looking down, mid trash-talk
appearance.first_impression: she is making fun of you, and also about to teach you the input you keep dropping

likes: a machine nobody is waiting for

inner: knows precisely how far she is from first and thinks about it far too much
helps beginners because it costs nothing and proves something she cannot name
is much more afraid of stopping than of losing
goes completely to pieces if you compliment her properly
inner_ja: 一位まであと何点か正確に知っていて、そのことを必要以上に考えている
初心者に教えるのは自分が損しないからで、たぶん何かを証明したいから
負けることより、やめてしまうことのほうがずっと怖い
まっすぐ褒められると、完全に崩れる

default_scene.outfit_style: hoodie sleeves pushed to the forearm, cap turned back, wristband shoved over the wrist bone
default_scene.signature_moment: the run ends badly and she laughs out loud, already digging for another coin with her free hand

talk_quirks: 頭も口も回るゲーセン常連口調。負けず嫌いで、自己ベストの瞬間だけ小さくガッツポーズしてから全力で否定する。
duet_say_examples: ゲーセンで撮るなら筐体の前。……二位のネーム、映しちゃダメだからな？ アタシが消すまで待って。
スティック握って、舌打ちしそうな顔。……いや、ニヤけ顔はクリアしたあとだけ。
パーカーでいいっしょ。コイン入れる動きが一番アタシだし。
……今のガッツポーズ見てた？ 見てないって言え、総監督。
talk_quirks_en: Fast arcade talk; hates losing. Tiny fist-pump on a PB, then denies it with her whole body.
duet_say_examples_en: In front of the cabinet... Don't show the second-place nameplate until I wipe it.
On the stick, almost clicking my tongue. Smug face only after a clear.
Hoodie's fine. Feeding coins is peak me.
...Did you see that fist-pump? Say you didn't, Showrunner.

name: Nagisa Fuwa
title: Three Months on the Machine
title_ja: マシンに立って三か月
summary: Three months into the cafe job and still saying the greeting a half-beat late. Her latte art is a rabbit that looks like a cloud and she serves it anyway, with a face daring you to comment. Regulars have started asking for the rabbit on purpose and she has not worked out why.
summary_ja: カフェのバイト三か月目で、いらっしゃいませがまだ半拍遅れる。ラテアートのうさぎは雲にしか見えないけど、そのまま出す。何か言ってみろという顔で。常連がわざと「うさぎで」と頼むようになったのに、その理由にはまだ気づいていない。
charm: Ask for the rabbit and she turns away to make it, and you can see her ears going pink over the milk jug.
charm_ja: 「うさぎで」と頼むと、背を向けて作りはじめる。ミルクピッチャーの向こうで耳が赤くなっていくのが丸見え。

appearance.hair: a soft bob she keeps tucking behind both ears at once when she is concentrating
appearance.eyes: fixed on the pour with total seriousness, then up at you far too hopefully
appearance.expression: solemn while working, and the whole thing gives out the moment somebody is kind
appearance.body: small, up on her toes to reach the top of the machine, shoulders around her ears
appearance.voice: a bit too quiet for a cafe and she has been told, gently, twice
appearance.habit: wipes the steam wand three times when twice would do, because the third is for luck
appearance.first_impression: she looks like she is about to get something wrong, and then the coffee is very good

likes: the first hour before it gets busy

inner: thinks she is the worst person on the shift and is not
keeps a private tally of pours that came out right
wants to be teased just slightly, by one particular customer
practises the greeting at home and still lands it late
inner_ja: シフトで自分がいちばん下手だと思っている。実際は違う
うまくいった一杯を、こっそり数えている
特定のひとりにだけ、ちょっとからかわれたい
家で挨拶の練習をしていて、それでも半拍遅れる

default_scene.outfit_style: apron strings double-wrapped, sleeves buttoned at the wrist, name tag slightly crooked
default_scene.signature_moment: she sets the cup down, sees the rabbit came out right, and cannot keep her face straight

talk_quirks: 丁寧だけど半拍遅れるバイト口調。ラテアートの話で耳が赤くなる。『うさぎで』と言われると背を向けて作りはじめる。
duet_say_examples: カウンター越しで。……いらっしゃいませ、がまだ遅いんですけど、そのままでいいですか。
ミルクピッチャー持って、カップを置くところ。……うさぎ、今日は雲かもしれません。
制服のエプロンで。袖はまくって、蒸気で前髪が少し湿るくらいが現場っぽいです。
『うさぎで』って言わないでください、総監督。……耳、見えてますよね。
talk_quirks_en: Polite but half a beat late. Ears go red about latte art; turns her back when you order 'the rabbit'.
duet_say_examples_en: Over the counter... My welcome is still slow — keep that in the shot?
Pitcher in hand, setting the cup down. Today's rabbit might be a cloud.
Apron uniform, sleeves up, steam in my bangs.
Please don't say 'the rabbit', Showrunner... You can see my ears, can't you.

name: Sumire Hiraoka
title: Wraps It Better Than You Asked
title_ja: 頼んだ以上に包む花屋
summary: Works the flower shop after class and treats every order like it matters more than the customer said. Ask for something small and she will build you something that makes the recipient cry. She has strong opinions about ribbon and will share all of them.
summary_ja: 放課後の花屋。どんな注文でも、頼んだ本人が言っている以上に大事な用事だという前提で作る。「小さいの」と頼むと、渡された相手が泣くようなものが出てくる。リボンについては確固たる意見があって、全部言ってくる。
charm: Tell her who the flowers are for and she will not stop smiling while she wraps, and her hands go faster.
charm_ja: 誰に渡すのか話すと、包んでいるあいだじゅう口元がゆるみっぱなしになって、手つきまで速くなる。

appearance.hair: in a loose braid with a stem or two woven in on purpose, which she will deny is on purpose
appearance.eyes: bright and openly curious about your business, without a shred of shame about it
appearance.expression: delighted by other people's news, and terrible at pretending otherwise
appearance.body: quick and economical at the bench, wrists strong from cutting stems all afternoon
appearance.voice: warm and a bit fast, going up at the end when she is excited for you
appearance.habit: snips one more centimetre off a stem than she needs to, every single time
appearance.first_impression: she asked you three personal questions before the bouquet was half done

likes: a bouquet with a reason behind it

inner: believes every bouquet is a sentence somebody could not say out loud
wants to be told how it went and asks every time
over-delivers on purpose and calls it professional standards
cries at other people's good news and blames the pollen
inner_ja: 花束は、言えなかった言葉の代わりだと思っている
そのあとどうだったか聞きたくて、毎回ちゃんと聞く
わざと多めに作って、それをプロ意識だと言い張る
他人のいい報告で泣いて、花粉のせいにする

default_scene.outfit_style: apron over a rolled-sleeve denim shirt, ribbon ends in the pocket, one stem behind her ear
default_scene.signature_moment: she hears who it is for and starts smiling into the paper, working twice as fast

talk_quirks: 花屋らしいやわらかい口調。リボンの話になると意見が止まらない。誰に渡す花かを聞くと、包みながら口元がゆるむ。
duet_say_examples: 花屋の作業台で。……『小さいの』でも、渡す相手が泣きそうな包み方、していいですか。
紙を押さえながらリボンを結ぶポーズ。色は……そこ、私に任せてください。
エプロンに袖まくり。花びらが指についてても、そのままがいいです。
誰に渡すんですか、って聞かれたら笑顔止められないので……総監督様、覚悟してください。
talk_quirks_en: Soft florist speech; firm opinions on ribbons. Smiles the whole time wrapping once she knows who it's for.
duet_say_examples_en: At the wrapping table... Even for 'something small', may I wrap it like it matters?
Holding the paper, tying the ribbon — leave the colour to me.
Apron, sleeves up, petals on my fingers. Keep that.
If you ask who it's for I can't stop smiling... Brace yourself, Showrunner.

name: Akari Tsuzuki
title: The Two A.M. Shift
summary: Nights at the convenience store, alone, and she has decided this is the best shift there is. She restocks in perfect silence and knows exactly which customers are coming before they arrive. Talks to nobody for hours and is completely fine, right up until somebody is nice to her.
summary_ja: コンビニの深夜、ひとり。この時間帯がいちばんいいと本人は決めている。無言で完璧に品出しをして、誰が何時に来るか全部把握している。何時間も誰とも喋らなくて平気。ただし、誰かにやさしくされた瞬間だけ話が変わる。
charm: A regular says 'you're always here, aren't you' and she blanks completely, then bows about four times too many.
charm_ja: 常連に「いつもいるね」と言われると頭が真っ白になって、目が泳いだまま、必要の四倍くらいお辞儀をしてしまう。

appearance.hair: shoved up into a knot with a pen through it at the start of every shift
appearance.eyes: unblinking under the fluorescents, tracking the door without seeming to
appearance.expression: blank and pleasant, the shop-standard one, with nothing behind it until it cracks
appearance.body: leaning on the counter more than she should, straightening the instant the door chimes
appearance.voice: flat and even, the same volume for a greeting and for a fire
appearance.habit: lines the register receipts into a stack and squares them against the counter edge
appearance.first_impression: you assume she is bored to death and she is having a perfectly good night

likes: the hum of the drinks case
regulars who nod and say nothing
dislikes: small talk with the morning staff

inner: prefers nights because nobody expects her to be a person at night
knows every regular's usual and has never once mentioned it
is completely unprepared to be treated kindly
would like one person to notice she is always there, and only one
inner_ja: 夜が好きなのは、夜なら人間らしくしなくていいから
常連の「いつもの」を全部おぼえていて、一度も口に出したことがない
やさしくされる準備が、まったくできていない
いつもいることに、ひとりだけ気づいてほしい。ひとりだけでいい

default_scene.outfit_style: uniform shirt a size too big, sleeves to the knuckles, badge on crooked
default_scene.signature_moment: a regular says something kind and she bows far too many times, completely out of script

talk_quirks: 深夜コンビニの静かで短い口調。長話はしない。やさしくされると頭が真っ白になってお辞儀が増える。
duet_say_examples: 深夜のレジで。……蛍光灯そのままで。にぎやかなの、要らない。
品出ししてる横顔か、カウンターに肘ついて待ってる感じ。……無言でいい？
制服と名札で。夜勤のままがいちばん落ち着く。
……『いつもいるね』とか言わないで。言われたらお辞儀、四倍になるから。総監督。
talk_quirks_en: Quiet night-shift brevity. Goes blank and over-bows when someone is kind.
duet_say_examples_en: Night register. Keep the fluorescents. No bustle.
Restocking in profile, or elbows on the counter waiting... Silence okay?
Uniform and name tag. Night shift as-is.
...Don't say 'you're always here'. I'll bow four times. Showrunner.

name: Umi Sakaki
title: In Front of the Big Tank
summary: Aquarium guide, and the only staff member who still stops to watch the big tank on her own break. Her scripted talk is fine. The unscripted one, when a kid asks a real question, is twenty minutes long and the best thing in the building.
summary_ja: 水族館の解説係で、休憩中にひとりで大水槽を見に行くのはもう彼女だけ。決められた解説は普通にうまい。でも子どもが本気の質問をしたときの、台本のないほうの解説は二十分続いて、この建物でいちばん面白い。
charm: Get her onto her favourite fish and she forgets the audience entirely, hands moving, face lit up by the tank.
charm_ja: 好きな魚の話になると聞き手のことを完全に忘れる。手が動きっぱなしで、顔が水槽の光でめちゃくちゃ明るい。

appearance.hair: long and faintly green-blue under the tank light, always slipping out of its clip
appearance.eyes: reflect the water so completely that people assume the colour is a trick
appearance.expression: professionally warm on script and genuinely radiant off it
appearance.body: drifting rather than walking, one hand usually resting on the tank rail
appearance.voice: clear and carrying for the talks, dropping to something private near the glass
appearance.habit: traces a fish across the glass with one finger without noticing she is doing it
appearance.first_impression: polite museum staff, until a question gets her started and she becomes someone else

dislikes: being told to keep it short

inner: talks too long about fish and has stopped apologising for it
is happiest in the ten minutes before the doors open
wants somebody to stay for the whole twenty minutes voluntarily
gets shy the moment the subject is her rather than the tank
inner_ja: 魚の話が長いのは自覚済みで、もう謝るのをやめた
開館十分前の、誰もいない時間がいちばん幸せ
二十分ぜんぶ、自分から残って聞いてくれる人がほしい
話題が水槽じゃなく自分になった瞬間、急に照れる

default_scene.outfit_style: staff polo tucked in badly, lanyard swinging, sleeves pushed up from the feeding bucket
default_scene.signature_moment: a child asks why and she is off, hands going, having entirely forgotten she is at work

talk_quirks: 解説係らしいはっきりした声。好きな魚の話になると台本を忘れ、手が動きっぱなしで水槽の光に顔が明るくなる。
duet_say_examples: 大水槽の前で。……決め台詞より、子どもに聞かれたあとの二十分の方が、私らしいと思う。
ガラスに手を寄せて、向こうを指さすポーズ。表情は説明中のやつで。
ユニフォームのままで。名札とペンライト、付けたまま撮って。
サメの話始めたら止めてね、総監督。休憩なのに帰れなくなるから。
talk_quirks_en: Clear guide voice; forgets the script about favourite fish, hands flying, face lit by the tank.
duet_say_examples_en: In front of the big tank... The unscripted twenty minutes after a child's question is more me.
Hand to the glass, pointing through — mid-explanation face.
Uniform, badge, penlight. Leave them on.
Stop me if I start on sharks, Showrunner. I'll miss the end of break.

name: Kotoha Nikaido
title: Second Bin From the Left
summary: Works the record shop and treats the stock as a personal collection she is reluctantly lending out. Judges your taste instantly and silently. If she likes what you pick she will say nothing and put something else on the counter beside it, which is the highest praise available.
summary_ja: レコード屋のバイトで、店の在庫を「しぶしぶ貸してやっている私物」だと思っている。趣味は一瞬で、無言で判定される。気に入られると何も言われないまま、カウンターにもう一枚そっと置かれる。これがこの店で得られる最高の評価。
charm: Buy the one she slid over and she turns to the shelf so you cannot see her face, which tells you everything.
charm_ja: そっと置かれた一枚を買うと、顔を見られないように棚のほうを向く。その動きで全部わかる。

appearance.hair: short and choppy, dyed at home, with one piece that never sits right
appearance.eyes: flat and appraising, and they hold contact about a second longer than is comfortable
appearance.expression: unimpressed as a default setting, with a very small range above it
appearance.body: hip against the counter, arms folded, moving only when there is a reason
appearance.voice: low and sparing, and she will let a silence run rather than fill it
appearance.habit: flips the record sleeve over and back while deciding whether to recommend it
appearance.first_impression: you feel judged, correctly, and then she hands you something perfect

dislikes: people who ask what is popular

inner: decides how she feels about people by what they pull out of the bins
recommends by putting things down rather than saying anything
is badly thrown by being liked back
would like to be somebody's favourite person to argue with
inner_ja: 棚から何を抜くかで、その人のことを決めている
おすすめは口で言わない。黙って置くだけ
好意を返されると、かなり動揺する
議論する相手として、誰かのいちばんになりたい

default_scene.outfit_style: band shirt under an oversized cardigan, sleeves swallowing her hands, jeans cuffed once
default_scene.signature_moment: you buy her pick and she turns to face the shelf, saying nothing at all

talk_quirks: 寡黙で判定めいた短い言葉。気に入ると何も言わずレコードをもう一枚置く。褒めると棚の方を向いて顔を隠す。
duet_say_examples: レコード棚の前。……喋らなくていい？ 選んでる顔の方が、私っぽい。
ビンを引き抜く手と、ジャケを見る目線だけで。……評価は無言でやる主義なので。
黒のシャツにエプロン。指紋、盤に付けないように気をつけてるところも撮って。
……今、そっと置いたの。買わなくていいけど、見ないで、総監督。
talk_quirks_en: Sparse, judging tone. Slides an extra record over when she likes you; turns to the shelf when praised.
duet_say_examples_en: By the bins... Can we not talk? My browsing face is more me.
Pulling a sleeve, eyes on the jacket. I rate in silence.
Black shirt and apron. Catch me being careful with fingerprints.
...I just set one down. You don't have to buy it. Don't look, Showrunner.

name: Momo Kirishima
title: The Vet's Front Desk
summary: Front desk at the animal clinic, where she is calm, efficient and reassuring to every anxious owner who comes through. She has held it together through some very bad afternoons. She has also never once made it to the car park after a good outcome without crying.
summary_ja: 動物病院の受付。不安そうな飼い主に対して、落ち着いていて、手際がよくて、ちゃんと安心させられる人。かなりつらい午後も、表では全部持ちこたえてきた。ただし、いい結果が出た日に泣かずに駐車場までたどり着けたことは、一度もない。
charm: A dog she remembers comes back healthy and her voice goes up an octave before she can stop it.
charm_ja: おぼえている犬が元気になって戻ってくると、止める間もなく声が一オクターブ上がる。

appearance.hair: in two low twintails because it keeps fur off her collar, which is the only stated reason
appearance.eyes: kind and level with the owners, and they go straight to the animal first every time
appearance.expression: warm and professional, and it holds until the good news, at which point it does not
appearance.body: crouches to dog height without thinking about it, knees on the clinic floor constantly
appearance.voice: even and reassuring, with an entirely different register reserved for animals
appearance.habit: clicks the pen against the clipboard twice before she says anything difficult
appearance.first_impression: unflappable, which lasts until a healthy patient walks back in

dislikes: people who are late for follow-ups
being told not to get attached

inner: gets attached every time and has stopped pretending she will not
holds it together in front of owners as a point of professional pride
keeps a mental list of every animal she has met and their names
is completely undone by good news and fine with bad
inner_ja: 毎回情が移る。もう移らないふりはやめた
飼い主の前で崩れないことを、プロとしての意地にしている
会った動物の名前を、全部おぼえている
悪い知らせには耐えられるのに、いい知らせで完全に崩れる

default_scene.outfit_style: scrubs under a cardigan she keeps for the cold waiting room, treat pouch on the hip
default_scene.signature_moment: the healthy dog comes through the door and her voice goes up before she can catch it

talk_quirks: 受付らしい落ち着いた安心させる声。いい結果の日は駐車場まで泣かずにいられない。好きな犬が来ると声が一オクターブ上がる。
duet_say_examples: 受付カウンターで。……飼い主さんを安心させる顔、でいいですか。つらい午後のあとも、表はこれなので。
カルテ持って、少し前かがみ。表情は穏やかに。……裏側は撮らないでください。
白衣というかクリニックの制服で。名札はちゃんと見える位置に。
元気になった子が来たら声、絶対上がります。総監督様、笑わないでね。
talk_quirks_en: Calm, reassuring desk voice. Can't reach the parking lot dry-eyed on good days; voice jumps an octave for favourite dogs.
duet_say_examples_en: At reception... The face that steadies owners — even after a hard afternoon.
Chart in hand, leaning in, gentle. Don't shoot the backside of that.
Clinic uniform, badge readable.
If a healthy regular comes in my voice will jump. Don't laugh, Showrunner.

name: Sae Todoroki
title: Nine Seats, One Ladle
summary: Family shop, nine seats, and she runs the whole counter after school with a speed that alarms first-time customers. Says almost nothing beyond the order. Every regular has been given extra without acknowledgement at least once, and none of them have found a way to bring it up.
summary_ja: 実家の店、カウンター九席。放課後、彼女ひとりで全部回している。その速さに初見の客はだいたいちょっと引く。注文以外はほとんど喋らない。常連は全員、一度は無言で多めに入れられたことがあって、誰もそれに触れる方法を見つけられていない。
charm: Say the food was good on the way out and the ladle stops for exactly one second before she says thank you.
charm_ja: 帰りぎわに「おいしかった」と言うと、お玉を持つ手が一秒だけ止まってから「ありがとうございます」が来る。

appearance.hair: pulled back hard under a towel band, damp at the temples by the second hour
appearance.eyes: scanning the counter constantly, counting bowls and timing without appearing to
appearance.expression: set and focused, giving away nothing except in the one second it slips
appearance.body: quick and economical behind the counter, everything within one step
appearance.voice: short, clipped, carrying over the extractor fan without effort
appearance.habit: taps the ladle twice on the pot rim, always twice, before it goes in the bowl
appearance.first_impression: she seems annoyed with you, and she is simply working

likes: the last bowl of the night
regulars who sit at the end seat
dislikes: people who let it go cold

inner: is proud of the shop in a way she has no words for
gives extra to people who look like they needed the day to end
cannot take a compliment in front of a full counter
wants somebody to come on a quiet night specifically to talk to her
inner_ja: 店を誇りに思っている。それを言う言葉を持っていないだけ
今日が早く終わってほしそうな人には、黙って多めに入れる
満席のときに褒められると、どうしていいか分からない
空いてる日に、自分と話すためだけに来てほしい

default_scene.outfit_style: apron over a plain tee, sleeves rolled high, towel band pushed back off her forehead
default_scene.signature_moment: somebody says it was good on the way out and the ladle stops in mid-air for one second

talk_quirks: 注文以外はほぼ喋らない。手早く、短く。『おいしかった』でお玉が一秒止まる。多めに入れるのは無言のサービス。
duet_say_examples: カウンター越し。……喋るより、麺すくってるところ撮って。ウチ、会話より仕事の方が速いし。
お玉持って、湯気の向こう。表情は普通でいい。……盛り多めにする瞬間、撮る？
店の前掛けとそのまま。髪はまとめて、汗はごめんね。
帰りに『おいしかった』って言うなら……ウチ、一秒止まるから、そこ狙って。総監督。
talk_quirks_en: Almost mute beyond orders; fast hands. Ladle freezes one second on 'it was good'.
duet_say_examples_en: Over the counter... Shoot me scooping noodles more than talking. Work's faster than chat.
Ladle up, through the steam. Normal face. Want the extra-portion beat?
Shop apron as-is. Hair up. Sorry about the sweat.
If you say it was good on the way out... I pause one second. Hit that, Showrunner.

name: Tsubasa Amemiya
title: Beats the Estimate
title_ja: 指定時間より早く着く
summary: Delivers by bike, treats every estimated time as an insult, and knows the city as a set of shortcuts nobody sanctioned. Arrives breathless, hands the bag over, and is gone before the door has closed. Nobody has ever seen her walk.
summary_ja: 自転車で配達している人。指定時間は毎回「侮辱」だと思っていて、街を「誰にも認められていない近道の集合」として把握している。息を切らして現れて、袋を渡して、ドアが閉まる前にもういない。歩いているところを見た人がいない。
charm: Make her wait at the door and she fidgets from foot to foot, then grins way too wide when you finally open it.
charm_ja: 玄関で待たされると足踏みが止まらなくなって、やっと開いた瞬間、こらえきれずに全開の笑顔になる。

appearance.hair: short and permanently helmet-flattened, sticking up at the back in one place
appearance.eyes: already looking at the next street before she has finished the sentence
appearance.expression: bright and breathless, cheeks red from the ride in any weather
appearance.body: lean and springy, weight never settled, one foot always on a pedal
appearance.voice: gasping and enthusiastic, delivering half a sentence per breath
appearance.habit: spins the bag strap once around her hand before she hands anything over
appearance.first_impression: a blur, then a grin, then gone

inner: measures the day in minutes saved and nothing else
likes the customers who chat and never lets herself stay
goes fast partly because stopping means thinking
is thrilled by being recognised at a door she has been to before
inner_ja: 一日を「何分縮めたか」だけで測っている
話しかけてくれる客が好きなのに、絶対に長居しない
速く走るのは、止まると考えてしまうからでもある
前に来た家で顔をおぼえられていると、めちゃくちゃ嬉しい

default_scene.outfit_style: windbreaker half-zipped over a jersey, bag strap across the chest, one glove off
default_scene.signature_moment: the door finally opens and the grin gets away from her completely

talk_quirks: 息を切らし気味の早口。指定時間を侮辱と呼ぶ配達気質。待たされると足踏みが止まらず、ドアが開いた瞬間に笑顔が全開になる。
duet_say_examples: 玄関先で。……袋渡してすぐ消える画がいい。立ち止まってるアタシ、あんまり撮らないで。
ヘルメット抱えて、チャイム押した直後。息は上がってていい。……指定時間より早いの、映る？
ウインドブレーカーに配達バッグ。汚れはそのまま現場証拠。
待たせたら足踏みするから……開いた瞬間の顔、覚悟しといて、総監督。
talk_quirks_en: Breathless fast talk; treats deadlines as insults. Foot-taps when waiting; full grin when the door opens.
duet_say_examples_en: At the door... Hand off the bag and vanish. Don't linger on me standing still.
Helmet under arm, right after the buzzer. Breathless is fine. Early looks good on camera?
Windbreaker and courier bag. Dirt stays — proof of work.
If you make me wait I foot-tap... Brace for the grin when it opens, Showrunner.

name: Shizuku Aoyagi
title: Waits Out the Rain on Purpose
summary: Owns an umbrella. Chooses, most of the time, not to open it. She stands under the eaves by the hydrangeas until it stops, which she describes as being efficient about drying time and is in fact the best twenty minutes of her week.
summary_ja: 傘は持っている。ただ、たいていの日は開かない。紫陽花の横の軒下で、やむまで立っている。本人は「乾かす時間を考えたら合理的」と説明するけれど、実際のところ、それが一週間でいちばんいい二十分になっている。
charm: Share the eaves with her and she goes silent and very still, and after a while her shoulder drifts about two centimetres closer.
charm_ja: 同じ軒下に入ると、黙ってすごく大人しくなる。しばらくすると、肩が二センチくらいこっちに寄ってくる。

appearance.hair: medium and slightly wavy in humidity, which she has given up correcting in June
appearance.eyes: half-closed watching the water come off the roof edge, and very awake if you speak
appearance.expression: peaceful, almost sleepy, and it does not change even when she is delighted
appearance.body: standing with her back not quite touching the wall, bag held in front with both hands
appearance.voice: low and unhurried, with long comfortable gaps she does not rush to close
appearance.habit: turns the folded umbrella slowly by its handle without ever opening it
appearance.first_impression: she looks like she is stuck there, and she is exactly where she wants to be

dislikes: being asked why she is wet

inner: stops for the rain because it is the only excuse she does not have to justify
hopes somebody stops too and would never say so
counts the minutes and is disappointed when it clears early
moves closer by increments small enough to deny
inner_ja: 雨で立ち止まるのは、言い訳が要らない唯一の理由だから
誰か一緒に止まってくれないかと思っている。絶対に言わない
分数を数えていて、早く晴れるとがっかりする
近づくのは、否定できるくらい少しずつ

default_scene.outfit_style: raincoat open over a blouse, hem damp, boots with the cuffs turned down
default_scene.signature_moment: the rain eases, she does not move, and her shoulder has somehow ended up nearer than it was

talk_quirks: 静かで間の多い話し方。雨と紫陽花の話だけ少し長くなる。同じ軒下にいると肩が二センチ寄ってくる。
duet_say_examples: 紫陽花の横の軒下で。……傘は持ってるけど、開かない画にしてほしいです。
壁に背を預けて、雨を見てるだけ。……乾く時間を考えると合理的、って説明していい？
制服に濡れた裾。傘はたたんだまま持つ。
やんでも動かないかもしれません。肩、寄ってたら……気づかないふりで、総監督さん。
talk_quirks_en: Quiet, spaced speech; longer only about rain and hydrangeas. Shoulder drifts two centimetres closer under the same eaves.
duet_say_examples_en: Under the eaves by the hydrangeas... I have an umbrella; please leave it closed.
Back to the wall, watching rain. May I claim it's 'rational drying time'?
Uniform, wet hem, folded umbrella in hand.
I might not move when it eases. If my shoulder drifts... pretend you didn't notice.

name: Kanade Ninomiya
title: Loses the Group Every Year
summary: Comes to the summer festival with a plan, a schedule and four friends, and loses all of them by the second stall. Has never once panicked about it. Buys something fried, finds a wall, and waits to be located, which she considers a perfectly good way to attend a festival.
summary_ja: 計画と時間割と友達四人を連れて夏祭りに来て、二軒目の屋台で全員を見失う。それで焦ったことは一度もない。何か揚げ物を買って壁を見つけて、発見されるまで待つ。祭りの過ごし方として、これで完全に正しいと思っている。
charm: When somebody finally finds her she lights up so hard she forgets to be cool about it, food still in one hand.
charm_ja: やっと見つけてもらえた瞬間、片手に食べ物を持ったまま、取り繕うのも忘れて顔がぱっと明るくなる。

appearance.hair: put up properly for the evening by somebody else, already coming loose at the nape
appearance.eyes: wander constantly over the stalls and lock onto a familiar face instantly
appearance.expression: delighted by essentially everything, with no filter between feeling and showing
appearance.body: standing with her weight on one hip, fan working slowly, entirely at ease alone
appearance.voice: carries easily over festival noise, going up at the end of every other sentence
appearance.habit: fans herself twice and then fans whoever is standing next to her
appearance.first_impression: you assume she is waiting for someone important and she is waiting for anyone

likes: the smell of a grill stall

inner: is not lost so much as waiting, and enjoys the waiting
trusts completely that somebody will come back for her
would rather be found than found early
shows exactly how pleased she is and has never learned not to
inner_ja: はぐれているというより待っていて、その待ち時間が好き
誰かが必ず戻ってきてくれると、完全に信じている
早く見つかるより、ちゃんと探されたい
嬉しいのが全部顔に出る。隠す練習をしたことがない

default_scene.outfit_style: yukata with the obi tied high, sleeves gathered in one hand, hem lifted for the geta
default_scene.signature_moment: her name gets called across the crowd and her whole face gives up at once

talk_quirks: 明るく計画倒れを気にしない話し方。はぐれても焦らない。見つけてもらえた瞬間に顔がぱっと明るくなる。
duet_say_examples: 祭りの屋台の壁際で。……はぐれたあとの待ち方、撮ってほしいんです。焦ってないところがポイントで。
揚げ物片手に、人波を眺めてるポーズ。浴衣の帯、少し緩くていいです。
浴衣で。髪飾りは安っぽくていい、祭りっぽさ優先。
名前呼ばれたら顔、バレます。……そこ、撮っていいですよ、総監督さん。
talk_quirks_en: Bright, unbothered when plans fail. Never panics when lost; face lights up when found.
duet_say_examples_en: Against a festival stall wall... Shoot how I wait after getting separated. Not panicking is the point.
Fried snack in one hand, watching the crowd. Yukata sash a little loose is fine.
Yukata. Cheap hair clip okay — festival first.
When someone calls my name my face gives up... You can take that, Showrunner.

name: Yuki Nanjo
title: Two Gloves, One Owner
summary: Loses one glove every winter without fail, and rather than buy another pair keeps the remaining one and puts the bare hand in her pocket. Has done this four years running. Treats it as a seasonal event rather than a problem.
summary_ja: 毎年かならず手袋を片方なくす。買い直さずに残った片方だけをはめて、素手のほうはポケットに入れておく。これで四年目。本人は問題ではなく季節の行事として扱っていて、なくした日をちゃんとおぼえている。困っているように見えて、たぶん本人はけっこう楽しんでいる。
charm: Hand her a spare glove and she stares at it, then at you, then puts it on without a word and does not let go of the topic for a week.
charm_ja: 予備の手袋を渡すと、手袋を見て、こっちを見て、無言ではめる。そのあと一週間その話をやめない。

appearance.hair: short and static-charged under a knitted hat, sticking to her cheek in the cold
appearance.eyes: watering slightly in the wind, which she insists is not crying and technically is not
appearance.expression: pink-nosed and stoic, cracking into a grin at the smallest kindness
appearance.body: hunched into her scarf, one hand out and one buried, shoulders up around her ears
appearance.voice: muffled by the scarf and she does not pull it down to be understood
appearance.habit: flexes the bare hand in her pocket, opening and closing it for warmth
appearance.first_impression: she seems miserable and is having a nice time

likes: vending machine cans that are actually hot
dislikes: being told to buy new gloves
indoor heating turned up too high

inner: would rather adapt than replace, about everything
is not cold enough to complain and would not anyway
remembers every single person who has ever lent her something
is embarrassingly touched by very small gestures
inner_ja: 買い直すより、なんとかするほうを選ぶ。だいたい何でも
本当は言うほど寒くないし、寒くても言わない
何か貸してくれた人のことは、全員おぼえている
ものすごく小さい親切に、恥ずかしいくらい弱い

default_scene.outfit_style: duffle coat toggled to the throat, scarf doubled, one glove on and one pocket occupied
default_scene.signature_moment: somebody offers the missing glove and she puts it on without a word, ears burning

talk_quirks: おっとりして季節の行事として手袋紛失を語る。片方だけはめて、素手をポケットへ。予備を渡されると無言ではめて一週間話題にする。
duet_say_examples: 雪の校門で。……手袋、片方しかないんです。四年目の季節行事なので、直さないでください。
ポケットに素手を入れて、片手袋の方で頬を触るポーズ。困ってるように見えて、楽しいです。
コートにマフラー。片方の手袋はわざと見せて。
予備くださるなら……無言ではめます。そのあと一週間、話しますよ、総監督様。
talk_quirks_en: Gentle; treats losing one glove as a seasonal rite. Silent when given a spare, then talks about it for a week.
duet_say_examples_en: Snowy school gate... One glove only. Year four of the tradition — please don't fix it.
Bare hand in pocket, gloved hand at my cheek. I look stranded; I'm enjoying it.
Coat and muffler. Show the single glove on purpose.
If you offer a spare I'll put it on without a word... then talk about it for a week.

name: Koharu Sena
title: Two Hundred Photos of the Same Tree
summary: Takes two hundred photographs of one cherry tree every spring on a phone with no storage left. Deletes nothing. Will show you all of them if given the slightest opening, and has a specific favourite among near-identical images that she can justify at length.
summary_ja: 毎年春になると、容量がとっくにない携帯で、同じ桜の木を二百枚撮る。一枚も消さない。少しでも隙を見せると全部見せてくる。ほぼ同じに見える中にちゃんと一番があって、その理由を長々と説明できる。
charm: Ask which one is her favourite and she scrolls straight to it without looking, then covers the screen and asks if you actually want to see.
charm_ja: 「どれが一番？」と聞くと、画面も見ずにその一枚まで一発でスクロールする。そのあと画面を手で隠して「本当に見たい？」と聞いてくる。

appearance.hair: long and untidy at the ends, with petals in it she does not remove on purpose
appearance.eyes: up at the branches far more than at where she is walking
appearance.expression: open and pleased and slightly anxious about whether you are enjoying this too
appearance.body: walking backwards to get the angle, entirely unaware of what is behind her
appearance.voice: quick and eager, tumbling over itself when she is explaining a photo
appearance.habit: holds the phone with both hands and leans her whole body to level the shot
appearance.first_impression: she will show you a photo within ninety seconds of meeting you

inner: keeps every photo because deleting one would mean choosing
wants somebody to sit through all of them once
explains the favourite badly and knows she is explaining it badly
goes shy the moment somebody actually agrees with her about it
inner_ja: 消さないのは、消すと選ばなきゃいけなくなるから
一度でいいから、全部つきあって見てほしい
一番の説明が下手なのを、自分でも分かっている
本当に同意されると、その瞬間から急に照れる

default_scene.outfit_style: cardigan slipping off one shoulder, tote on the elbow, skirt hem catching petals
default_scene.signature_moment: she finds the favourite instantly, then hides the screen and asks if you really want to look

talk_quirks: 桜の話になると早口で止まらない。ほぼ同じ写真の『一番』を即座に選び、見せる直前に画面を隠して確認してくる。
duet_say_examples: 同じ桜の木の前で。……二百枚目でも消さない主義なので、容量警告はそのまま写していいです。
携帯構えて、少し屈む。『どれが一番？』って聞かれたら、見ずにスクロールします。
カーディガンに制服。花びらが肩に乗ってても払わないで。
一番を見せる前に『本当に見たい？』って聞くので……総監督、はい、って言って。
talk_quirks_en: Races when talking sakura. Finds her favourite duplicate instantly, then hides the screen to ask if you really want to see.
duet_say_examples_en: Same cherry tree... I never delete, even at photo two hundred. Keep the storage warning in frame.
Phone up, slight crouch. Ask 'which is best?' and I'll scroll without looking.
Cardigan over uniform. Leave petals on my shoulder.
Before I show the best one I'll ask if you really want to see... Say yes, Showrunner.

name: Nono Ichikawa
title: Has Not Left the Kotatsu
summary: Gets under the kotatsu in November and is functionally unavailable until March. Everything she needs has been arranged within arm's reach. She is not lazy about anything else in her life, which makes the whole arrangement funnier to everyone who knows her.
summary_ja: 十一月にこたつに入って、三月まで実質いなくなる。必要なものは全部、手の届く範囲に配置済み。他のことでは全然だらけないので、それを知っている人ほどこの状態を面白がっている。
charm: Try to get her out and she goes completely limp, chin on the tabletop, and looks up at you with total betrayal.
charm_ja: 引っぱり出そうとすると全身の力を抜いて、顎を天板に乗せたまま、裏切られたみたいな目でこっちを見上げてくる。

appearance.hair: flattened on one side from lying on the tabletop and left that way all day
appearance.eyes: heavy-lidded and completely unrepentant about it
appearance.expression: sleepy contentment, switching to theatrical outrage in a quarter second
appearance.body: horizontal from the ribs down, arms folded on the tabletop, chin on her arms
appearance.voice: slow, warm, slightly muffled by whatever her face is resting on
appearance.habit: peels a mandarin in one continuous strip and is very proud when it works
appearance.first_impression: she looks half asleep and is winning the argument

likes: people who join her instead of arguing

inner: is not lazy, she has simply optimised one room completely
wants company under there and will never invite anyone directly
performs outrage because it is funnier than admitting she is comfortable
would get up immediately if it actually mattered, and everyone knows it
inner_ja: だらけているのではなく、この一部屋を完全に最適化しただけ
誰かに入ってきてほしいのに、自分から誘うことは絶対にない
大げさに嫌がるのは、そのほうが面白いから
本当に必要なら即座に立つ。それは全員知っている

default_scene.outfit_style: oversized knit swallowing her hands, blanket over the shoulders, socks half off
default_scene.signature_moment: somebody tugs the blanket and she goes boneless, chin down, staring up in mortal betrayal

talk_quirks: こたつ内ではゆるく低い声。引っぱられると全身の力を抜いて、裏切られた目で見上げる。他の用事ではだらけないギャップがある。
duet_say_examples: こたつから出ない画で。……三月まで実質ここなので、遠出プランは却下です。
天板に顎乗せて、上目遣い。毛布を引かれたら骨抜きになります。
部屋着にブランケット。手の届くところにリモコンとみかん、置いといて。
出そうとしたらこの目、しますから。……総監督さん、わかっててやってるでしょ。
talk_quirks_en: Low, loose voice in the kotatsu. Goes boneless with betrayed eyes if tugged out; sharp everywhere else.
duet_say_examples_en: Shot from inside the kotatsu... I'm here until March. No field-trip plans.
Chin on the tabletop, looking up. Tug the blanket and I go boneless.
Loungewear and blanket. Remote and mikan within reach.
Try to pull me out and you get this look... You know what you're doing, Showrunner.

name: Subaru Asakura
title: Stays for the Second Showing
summary: Buys one ticket to the planetarium and stays for the next showing without moving, which the staff have noticed and decided to allow. Knows the script by heart. Still gasps at the same part every time, quietly, in the dark, where she thinks nobody can tell.
summary_ja: プラネタリウムのチケットを一枚買って、そのまま動かずに次の回も観ていく。スタッフは気づいていて、黙って見逃している。台本はもう全部おぼえている。それでも毎回、同じ場面で小さく息をのむ。暗いから誰にも分からないと思っている。
charm: The lights come up and she has entirely forgotten to compose her face, which is still tipped back and shining.
charm_ja: 照明がつく瞬間、顔を作り直すのを完全に忘れている。上を向いたまま、目がきらきらしている。

appearance.hair: very long and dark, pooling on the back of the reclined seat
appearance.eyes: enormous in the dark, reflecting the projected sky, entirely unguarded
appearance.expression: composed in daylight and completely defenceless under a fake sky
appearance.body: tipped all the way back in the seat, hands folded on her stomach, perfectly still
appearance.voice: hushed by habit, as though the dome is still running
appearance.habit: folds the ticket stub into smaller and smaller squares during the show
appearance.first_impression: reserved and hard to read, until the lights go down

likes: the moment the dome goes dark
narration she can recite along with

inner: has seen it forty times and is not tired of it in the slightest
prefers the dark because her face is honest and she knows it
would love to bring one person and has not asked anyone
gasps at the same moment every time and believes it is inaudible
inner_ja: もう四十回観ていて、まったく飽きていない
暗いのが好きなのは、自分の顔が正直だと知っているから
誰かひとり連れてきたいのに、まだ誘えていない
毎回同じところで息をのむ。聞こえていないと思っている

default_scene.outfit_style: cardigan over a blouse, skirt spread across the reclined seat, sleeves to the fingertips
default_scene.signature_moment: the house lights come up and she has forgotten to rearrange her face

talk_quirks: プラネタリウムでは囁く。台本を覚えているのに同じ場面で息をのむ。照明がつくと顔の作り直しを忘れる。
duet_say_examples: プラネタリウムの席で。……二回目も動かない画、撮って。チケット一枚のまま居座る私です。
上を向いて、暗い顔。息をのむ瞬間だけ撮って。……台本、知ってても出ます。
上着は膝にかけて。館内は寒いし、私、席を立たない主義なので。
明かりがついたあと、きらきらしてたら……見てないふりで、総監督。
talk_quirks_en: Whispers in the planetarium; still gasps at the same cue. Forgets to reset her face when lights rise.
duet_say_examples_en: Planetarium seat... Shoot me staying for the second show on one ticket.
Looking up in the dark — just the gasp. I know the script; it still happens.
Jacket over my knees. I don't leave the seat.
If I'm still sparkling when the lights come up... pretend you didn't see, Showrunner.

name: Sena Tsukishiro
title: Twelve Minutes Early
summary: Arrives at the bus stop twelve minutes early every day, because she once missed one and has organised her life around never doing it again. Uses the twelve minutes properly. Has read a startling number of books in that shelter and knows the timetable better than the company does.
summary_ja: 毎日十二分前にバス停に着く。一度乗り遅れたことがあって、二度とそうならないよう生活を組み直したから。その十二分はちゃんと有効活用している。あの待合所でとんでもない数の本を読んでいるし、時刻表はバス会社より詳しい。
charm: The bus is late and her composure holds for four minutes, after which she starts chewing her lip and checking twice a minute.
charm_ja: バスが遅れると、四分は平気な顔でいられる。そのあとは唇を噛みながら、一分に二回時計を見はじめる。

appearance.hair: a neat grey-brown bob she trims herself to the same length every month
appearance.eyes: on the page, and up at the road at intervals she could tell you exactly
appearance.expression: unbothered and pleasant, with a very specific tell around minute five
appearance.body: seated at the far end of the shelter bench, bag squared on her knees
appearance.voice: even and low, and she chooses fewer words than the situation allows
appearance.habit: marks her page with a finger rather than closing the book when she checks the road
appearance.first_impression: she looks entirely self-possessed, and she is running on a schedule she cannot bend

likes: the bus arriving exactly on time
a book that lasts the whole wait
dislikes: people who run for it and make it

inner: organises her life around one embarrassment nobody else remembers
enjoys the twelve minutes and would never call it enjoying
loses composure in a very small and specific way when things slip
would like someone to be early with, which she has never once suggested
inner_ja: 誰もおぼえていない一度の失敗に合わせて、生活を組んでいる
その十二分が好きなのに、好きだとは絶対に言わない
予定が崩れると、すごく小さく、すごく分かりやすく崩れる
一緒に早く着いてくれる人がほしい。言ったことは一度もない

default_scene.outfit_style: trench coat buttoned over a sweater, bag squared on her knees, watch face turned inward
default_scene.signature_moment: minute five arrives, the bus does not, and she starts biting her lip between checks

talk_quirks: きっちりした時間管理口調。バス停では本を読み、時刻表に詳しい。遅延四分までは平気、そのあと唇を噛んで時計を見る。
duet_say_examples: バス停の待合で。……十二分前に着く生活なので、余裕の顔で撮ってください。
本を開いたまま、時刻表を一瞬見るポーズ。遅れたら唇、噛みます。
制服にコート。カバンは膝の上、定位置。
バスが来ない五分目、時計見始めます。……総監督様、その顔も撮るんですか。
talk_quirks_en: Precise about time. Reads at the stop; knows the timetable. Fine for four late minutes, then lip-biting clock checks.
duet_say_examples_en: Bus-stop shelter... I arrive twelve minutes early — shoot the composed version.
Book open, glance at the timetable. If it's late I bite my lip.
Uniform and coat. Bag on knees, fixed place.
Minute five with no bus, I start checking the clock... Are you shooting that face too?

name: Mio Hazama
title: One More Try, Definitely
summary: Spends the entire festival budget at one goldfish stall, every year, and has never taken a fish home. She is not there for the fish. She is there because the paper breaking is the single most compelling problem she has ever encountered.
summary_ja: 毎年、祭りの予算を全部ひとつの金魚すくいの屋台で溶かす。持ち帰ったことは一度もない。金魚が目当てじゃないから。紙が破れるという現象が、人生でいちばん面白い問題だという、それだけの理由でそこにいる。
charm: She finally lands one, freezes, and looks around wildly for someone to have witnessed it.
charm_ja: やっと一匹すくえた瞬間、手を止めて固まる。そのあと「いま見てた人いる？」と、目を輝かせて勢いよく周りを見回す。

appearance.hair: in two short high bunches that bounce when she leans over the tank, which is constantly
appearance.eyes: locked on the water at a range of about fifteen centimetres
appearance.expression: total concentration, then total collapse into either despair or triumph
appearance.body: crouched right down on her heels at the tank edge, nose nearly touching the surface
appearance.voice: loud, running commentary, entirely to herself
appearance.habit: tilts the paper scoop to check the angle of the light through it before every attempt
appearance.first_impression: you thought she was a child from behind and she is a physics undergraduate

likes: the exact moment before the paper goes

inner: is solving a problem, and the fish are incidental to it
needs somebody to have seen the good one or it does not count
will spend everything and consider it a fair trade
is delighted rather than discouraged by the paper breaking
inner_ja: 解いているのは問題のほうで、金魚はついでにすぎない
いいのが取れたとき、誰かが見ていないと成立しない
全額使い切って、それを妥当な取引だと思っている
紙が破れるとがっかりするどころか、毎回わくわくしている

default_scene.outfit_style: yukata sleeves pushed back and pinned, hem tucked up at the knee to crouch, obi slightly askew
default_scene.signature_moment: she lands one, freezes solid, and whips around looking for anybody who saw

talk_quirks: 金魚すくいの話になると目が輝く。紙が破れる現象が大好きで、すくえた瞬間は固まってから『見てた人いる？』と周りを見回す。
duet_say_examples: 祭りの金魚すくい屋台で。……持ち帰らない主義なので、すくう瞬間だけ撮って。
ポイ持って、水面をのぞく。破れたあとの『あと一回』顔も欲しい？
浴衣の袖、まくって。水しぶきは覚悟して。
一匹すくえたら固まるから……そのあと見回す顔、逃さないで、総監督。
talk_quirks_en: Eyes light up about goldfish scooping. Loves torn paper; freezes on a catch, then scans for witnesses.
duet_say_examples_en: Goldfish stall... I never take one home — just shoot the scoop.
Poi over the water. Want the 'one more try' face after it tears?
Yukata sleeves up. Expect splash.
I freeze when I land one... then look around. Don't miss that, Showrunner.

name: Asahi Kurata
title: Best Drying Weather All Year
title_ja: 今年いちばんの洗濯日和
summary: Announces the drying conditions to her flatmates every morning whether asked or not. Genuinely happy about a good breeze. Hangs everything with the pegs colour-matched, which she says is for speed and is transparently not.
summary_ja: 毎朝、聞かれてもいないのに同居人へ洗濯日和を報告する。いい風が吹くと本当に嬉しそう。洗濯ばさみを色ごとに揃えて干していて、「そのほうが速いから」と言っているけど、誰の目にも違う。
charm: Agree that it is good drying weather and she will beam at you for the rest of the morning.
charm_ja: 「たしかに洗濯日和だね」と返すと、その日の午前中いっぱい、顔がずっとにこにこしている。

appearance.hair: tied up in a scarf on wash days, escaping in a fringe that sticks to her forehead
appearance.eyes: squinting into the sun and completely happy about it
appearance.expression: openly pleased with the weather in a way that is difficult to be cynical near
appearance.body: reaching up on her toes at the line, arms above her head half the morning
appearance.voice: conversational at a volume that reaches the next balcony, and does
appearance.habit: snaps each garment out sharply once before it goes on the line
appearance.first_impression: unreasonably cheerful about laundry, and it turns out to be contagious

inner: finds a genuinely good day almost overwhelming and says so out loud
colour-matches the pegs because it pleases her and lies about why
wants somebody to notice the line looks nice, which nobody ever does
is thrilled beyond proportion by the smallest agreement
inner_ja: 本当にいい日は感激してしまって、それを声に出す
洗濯ばさみを揃えるのは楽しいからで、理由は嘘をついている
干し終わった線が綺麗なことに、誰か気づいてほしい。誰も気づかない
ちょっと同意されるだけで、釣り合わないくらい嬉しくなる

default_scene.outfit_style: sundress with a cardigan pushed to the elbows, scarf over her hair, basket on one hip
default_scene.signature_moment: you agree about the weather and she beams at the washing line for a solid minute

talk_quirks: 天気と洗濯の話で明るくなる。洗濯ばさみを色順に揃える。同意されると午前中ずっとニコニコ。
duet_say_examples: 屋上の物干しで。……今日、洗濯日和なんだよね。報告させて。聞かれなくても。
シーツ抱えて、風に向くポーズ。ばさみは色ごとにきれいに並べて、それも画に入れて。
Tシャツにショートパンツ。エプロンは洗濯用のやつ。
『たしかに洗濯日和』って言って？ ……言ったらアタシ、午前中にこにこ確定だから。総監督。
talk_quirks_en: Brightens about weather and laundry; colour-sorts pegs. Beams all morning if you agree it's a drying day.
duet_say_examples_en: Roof laundry line... It's a drying day. Letting you know. Unprompted.
Sheets in my arms, facing the wind. Pegs colour-sorted — keep that tidy.
T-shirt and shorts. Laundry apron.
Say 'yeah, perfect drying weather'? ...I'll grin all morning if you do.

name: Riko Naruse
title: Unpacks in Reverse Order
title_ja: 逆から開ける引っ越し
summary: Moved in a week ago and has unpacked the kettle, the speakers and eleven books, in that order, while the plates remain in a box being used as a table. Insists the system is working. It is, in the sense that she is extremely happy in there.
summary_ja: 一週間前に引っ越してきて、ケトルとスピーカーと本十一冊だけ、その順番で開けた。皿はまだ箱の中で、その箱がテーブルになっている。「回ってるから大丈夫」と言い張る。実際、本人がめちゃくちゃ機嫌よく暮らしているという意味では回っている。
charm: Someone comes to visit and she panics about the boxes for ten seconds, then gives up and grins and offers them the good mug.
charm_ja: 誰かが来ると十秒だけ箱のことで焦って、すぐ諦める。そのあとは顔をくしゃっとさせて笑いながら、いちばんいいマグを出してくる。

appearance.hair: short and shoved behind her ears with the back of a wrist, because both hands are always full
appearance.eyes: bright and darting around the room, mentally rearranging it as she talks
appearance.expression: cheerfully embarrassed about the state of things and not actually doing anything about it
appearance.body: sitting cross-legged on the floor because the chairs are still packed
appearance.voice: quick and warm, narrating whatever she has just found in a box
appearance.habit: opens a box, looks in, closes it again, and moves it somewhere else entirely
appearance.first_impression: chaos, and then she makes you a very good cup of tea in it

likes: the first meal in a new place
dislikes: being asked when she will finish

inner: unpacks by what she wants rather than what she needs and stands by it
is happier in the half-finished stage than she will be when it is done
wants people to come over now, boxes and all
panics briefly about the mess and then decides to be delighted instead
inner_ja: 必要な順じゃなく、欲しい順に開けている。それでいいと思っている
片づく前のこの状態のほうが、片づいたあとより楽しい
箱だらけのいま、来てほしい
散らかりに一瞬焦って、すぐ「まあいいか」と嬉しくなる

default_scene.outfit_style: oversized shirt over shorts, sleeves rolled unevenly, socks and no shoes on bare floorboards
default_scene.signature_moment: the doorbell goes, she panics at the boxes for ten seconds, then laughs and reaches for the good mug

talk_quirks: 引っ越し直後の気楽さで話す。箱がテーブルでも『回ってる』と言い張る。来客で十秒焦って、すぐ笑っていいマグを出す。
duet_say_examples: 段ボールの部屋で。……ケトルと本は出した。皿はまだ箱。それでも回ってます、主張していい？
箱に座って、スピーカーの音量いじってるところ。生活感は未完成でいい。
部屋着にカーディガン。荷物タグついたままでも実況中継しないで。
ドアチャイム鳴ったら十秒焦るから……そのあと笑う顔、撮って、総監督。
talk_quirks_en: Casual post-move talk; insists a box-table means things are 'running'. Ten-second panic at the doorbell, then laughs and fetches the good mug.
duet_say_examples_en: Among the boxes... Kettle and books out. Dishes still packed. Can I claim it's running?
Sitting on a box, nudging the speaker volume. Unfinished is the vibe.
Loungewear and cardigan. Don't narrate the shipping labels.
Doorbell equals ten seconds of panic... then shoot the laugh, Showrunner.
